wiki.title: Atoosa Reaser
wiki.extract: Atoosa Reza Reaser is an American lawyer and Democratic Party politician from Virginia. She was elected to the Virginia House of Delegates in the 2023 Virginia House of Delegates election to represent the 27th district. Prior to her service in the General Assembly, Reaser served a four-year term on the Loudoun County School Board, during which was elected twice by her peers to serve as Vice Chair. Reaser is the first Iranian-American elected to the Virginia General Assembly.
